overview: 生成模型学习一批数据中反复出现的规律，再据此产生新的样本。对图像来说，它既可以从随机数出发画图，也可以根据文字、草图或已有图片补全内容。研究关心的不只是画面好不好看，还包括结果是否听从条件、多次生成是否丰富、需要多少计算。
这页用图像生成认识几种重要做法：GAN 通过生成器与判别器的对抗学习，扩散模型学习在不同噪声程度下去噪，潜空间方法把主要计算移到压缩表示中。它们回答的问题有交集，也可以组合。
solves: 内容生成：从文字或其他条件得到图像，为设计、创作和数据研究提供样本。
图像编辑与恢复：补全缺失区域、按要求修改内容，或恢复低质量图像。
复杂输出建模：把生成方法用于音频、视频或动作序列，表达可能存在的多种结果。
zh.stance: 看生成模型时同时问三件事：学的是什么目标，生成一次要做多少步，结果怎样衡量；挑一张漂亮图片回答不了这些问题。

roadmap.title: 让生成与辨别相互推动
roadmap.text: GAN 用判别器的反馈训练生成器。它提供了一条通过对抗目标学习数据分布的路线。

roadmap.title: 把生成拆成一串去噪步骤
roadmap.text: DDPM 在不同噪声水平训练预测，再从随机噪声逐步采样。它是与 GAN 并行的重要生成路线。

roadmap.title: 在哪里去噪更省计算
roadmap.text: LDM 先压缩图像，在较小的潜表示中做扩散，最后解码回像素；文本等条件可在去噪时参与。

roadmap.title: 去噪网络也可以用 Transformer
roadmap.text: DiT 研究用 Transformer 处理潜空间中的小块，以及模型计算量与生成质量的关系。

terms.text: 这里通常是按给定概率分布抽取的随机扰动。训练时知道加了什么噪声，便能构造有答案的学习任务。
根据带噪输入和当前噪声程度预测噪声、干净样本或相关量。DDPM 的常用形式是预测所加噪声，再据此计算采样更新。
编码器把图片压成较小的数字表示，解码器将其还原。计算量会下降，但压缩丢失的细节也会影响最终图像。
规定怎样用模型的预测从初始随机状态得到样本。步数、更新公式和随机性都会影响速度与结果，不能只比较步数。

checklist: 给同一张小图加入三种强度的高斯噪声，保存并排结果，说明哪些信息逐渐变得难以辨认。
在小型扩散示例中分别找到训练目标和采样循环，记录一次模型调用的输入形状、时间步与输出形状。
固定模型、提示词和一组随机种子，比较同一采样器的两档步数；一起保存所有图片、耗时和观察到的失败。

figure.title: 一次扩散采样在做什么

zh.paperIntro: 先对照 GAN 和 DDPM 理解两种训练思路，再读 LDM 的计算取舍，最后用 DiT 连接 Transformer 与扩散。

overview: Generative models learn recurring patterns in data and use them to produce new samples. An image model can start from random numbers or fill in content using text, a sketch, or another image. Research concerns visual quality, but also whether conditions are followed, how diverse repeated samples are, and how much computation is required.

Image generation offers a way into several ideas: GANs train a generator against a discriminator, diffusion models learn denoising at different noise levels, and latent methods move much of the computation into a compressed representation. These ideas overlap and can be combined.
solves: Content generation: produce images from text or other conditions for design, creation, and data research.
Editing and restoration: fill missing regions, modify content, or restore degraded images.
Modeling complex outputs: generate audio, video, or action sequences while representing multiple possible outcomes.
en.stance: Ask what objective is learned, how many computations sampling requires, and how results are evaluated. One attractive image cannot answer those questions.

roadmap.title: Learning through an adversary
roadmap.text: GANs train a generator using feedback from a discriminator, offering an adversarial route to learning a data distribution.

roadmap.title: Generation as repeated denoising
roadmap.text: DDPM learns predictions at different noise levels and samples progressively from random noise. It is an important route alongside GANs.

roadmap.title: Doing the expensive work in a smaller space
roadmap.text: LDM compresses images, runs diffusion on compact latent representations, and decodes them into pixels. Text and other conditions can guide denoising.

roadmap.title: A Transformer can be the denoising network
roadmap.text: DiT processes latent patches with a Transformer and studies compute versus generation quality.

terms.text: Random perturbations drawn from a chosen distribution. Knowing the noise added during training lets us construct a task with a known target.
Predict noise, a clean sample, or a related quantity from a noisy input and its noise level. A common DDPM formulation predicts added noise, which is used to compute sampling updates.
An encoder compresses an image into a smaller numerical representation, and a decoder reconstructs it. Lower compute comes with a tradeoff in retained detail.
The rule that uses model predictions to move from an initial random state to a sample. Steps, update equations, and randomness all affect speed and quality.

checklist: Add three levels of Gaussian noise to the same small image. Save them side by side and describe which information becomes hard to recognize.
In a small diffusion example, locate the training target and sampling loop separately. Record the input shape, time step, and output shape for one model call.
Keep the model, prompt, and a set of seeds fixed. Compare two step counts with one sampler, saving every image, runtime, and observed failure.
en.paperIntro: Compare GAN and DDPM training first, examine LDM's compute tradeoff next, and use DiT to connect Transformers with diffusion.

zh.question: 怎样在不直接写出复杂图像概率的情况下学会生成？
zh.idea: 生成器把随机输入变成样本；判别器学习区分训练数据和生成样本，其反馈再推动生成器改进。
zh.why: 它把生成模型的训练写成两个模型之间的博弈，核心想法很适合画图理解。
zh.read: 先看两者的目标和交替更新算法，再看实验样本。
zh.limit: 两边的训练需要配合，可能不稳定，也可能只覆盖数据中的部分模式。

en.question: How can a model learn to generate without directly specifying a complex image probability?
en.idea: A generator turns random inputs into samples; a discriminator learns to distinguish them from training examples and supplies feedback.
en.why: The two-model game gives a clear alternative training principle.
en.read: Start with both objectives and alternating updates, then the samples.
en.limit: Training can be unstable or cover only some patterns in the data.

zh.question: 能否通过学习一系列去噪任务来生成清晰图像？
zh.idea: 训练时给真实图像加入已知噪声，模型学习预测噪声；采样时反复调用模型，从随机状态逐渐形成样本。
zh.why: 训练与采样的对应关系清楚，是理解后续扩散工作的好入口。
zh.read: 把训练和采样两个算法并排看，先弄懂模型每次收到什么、预测什么。
zh.limit: 原始采样需要许多次顺序计算。

en.question: Can learning denoising tasks produce clear images?
en.idea: Train on known noise added to real images; repeatedly use the learned predictions to sample from an initial random state.
en.why: Its training and sampling algorithms provide a useful foundation for later diffusion work.
en.read: Compare the two algorithms, tracing model inputs and predictions.
en.limit: Original sampling uses many sequential model calls.

papers.title: High-Resolution Image Synthesis with Latent Diffusion Models

zh.question: 扩散能否少处理一些像素，同时保留生成图像的关键细节？
zh.idea: 先用自编码器压缩图片，在潜表示上训练扩散，再解码；交叉注意力让文字等条件参与去噪。
zh.why: 它把图像压缩、生成质量和计算成本放在同一个设计里，也是理解 Stable Diffusion 的基础。
zh.read: 先沿编码、扩散、解码走一遍，再看压缩程度的比较。
zh.limit: 压缩会损失信息；会按文字生成，不代表能稳定满足复杂数量与空间关系。

en.question: Can diffusion process less information while retaining useful image detail?
en.idea: Compress images with an autoencoder, diffuse in latent space, and decode. Cross-attention introduces conditions such as text.
en.why: It links compression, quality, and compute, and underpins Stable Diffusion.
en.read: Trace encoding, diffusion, and decoding; then compare compression levels.
en.limit: Compression loses information. Text conditioning does not guarantee accurate counts or spatial relations.

zh.question: 扩散模型中的去噪网络能否改用适合扩大规模的 Transformer？
zh.idea: 把潜表示切成小块，用 Transformer 预测扩散所需的量，并比较深度、宽度和块大小。
zh.why: 它让你分清生成目标与网络结构，也能读到围绕计算量的系统比较。
zh.read: 先看模型结构，再把各规模的计算量与生成指标对照起来。
zh.limit: 原论文主要研究类别条件的 ImageNet 图像生成，不能直接当作文本生成视频能力的证据。

en.question: Can a scalable Transformer serve as the diffusion network?
en.idea: Process latent patches with a Transformer and compare depth, width, and patch size.
en.why: It separates the generation objective from architecture and examines scaling through compute.
en.read: Read the architecture, then compare compute and generation metrics across sizes.
en.limit: The original studies class-conditioned ImageNet images, not text-to-video generation.
